en: Black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a busy European square lined with early 20th‑century buildings. People in period clothing gather at outdoor café tables and walk through the square. A two‑storey corner building bears an awning sign reading "MATARASSO‑SARAGOUSSI et ROUSSO." At the bottom, bilingual French‑English captions describe the view as a corner of Republic Place in Salonique/Salonica.
